acceptance: Every action pin in the fork's .github/workflows that targets Node.js 20 is moved to a release that targets Node.js 24, still pinned by full commit SHA with a version comment.
A run of each changed workflow (dispatch or PR) logs no 'Node.js 20 is deprecated' annotation.
A dry-run dispatch of benchbox-upstream.yml still completes prepare, readiness and publish as before.
context:
Decision gate: none for same-major or minimal upgrades. If the only Node 24 release of an action is a new major with breaking inputs (for example upload-artifact or download-artifact behaviour changes), read its release notes and record the change in the PR body; get owner approval only if the workflow's behaviour or permissions would change.

Verification rubric: (1) list every 'uses:' pin in the fork workflows before and after; (2) each changed workflow runs once without the Node 20 annotation; (3) downstream contract tests that read the workflows pass; (4) the controller dry run and the write-confinement contract test pass.

Guardrails: keep full-SHA pins (no tags or branches); no permission, token or job-structure changes; workflow changes go through a human-reviewed fork PR; one PR for all pins.

Review 2026-11-17 (todo review, L2): scope is the fork repository's workflows only. The Node 20 warning was seen in benchbox-upstream.yml runs; other fork workflows were not checked when filing, so the first step is a full 'uses:' inventory. BenchBox core workflows were not inspected; if they log the same warning, file a separate core item rather than widening this one.

Owner decision 2026-11-17 (choice dialog): bundle into the fork PR with the drift probe fix and issue routing; the owner reviews it. A major-version upgrade is allowed if inputs, permissions and job structure stay the same.
description: Every benchbox-upstream.yml run since at least 2026-11-15 (for example run 43881204346) logs: 'Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02, astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e.' The runs still pass, but these pins are running on a runtime they were not released for, and other fork workflows may use the same pins. The controller is unattended, so a runtime break would stop refreshes silently until someone reads the failed run.
